jutsu.name: Stormsinger
jutsu.description: A powerful stormy chakra surrounds the user.
jutsu.battleDescription: Calling upon the divine power of Susanoo, %user becomes one with the storm, their presence merging with the crackling energy in the air.

jutsu.name: Sounds of Tempest
jutsu.description: This jutsu channels lightning chakra through the target causing their very blood to become toxic to them.
jutsu.battleDescription: As the tempest rages, %user's eyes begin to glow with a dark blue radiance, mirroring the eye of the storm growing within, intensifying the ferocity and might of the unleashed power. %user then melds the forces of lightning and water, birthing "Akuma no Arashi", a cataclysmic storm of unparalleled power. The merging elements surge forth, enveloping %target and battlefield, a single bolt of lightning strikes them.

jutsu.name: Demons Strike
jutsu.description: Call down a powerful storm strike on an area while raising a temporary shield around yourself.
jutsu.battleDescription: as the storm rages on,  %user calls upon the power of the storm, forming a fearsome lightning strike from within the clouds. The demonic lightning descends with tremendous speed and force, crashing into %target with overwhelming power.

jutsu.name: Braced Stance
jutsu.battleDescription: %user braces to absorb the coming blows.

jutsu.name: Death’s Storm
jutsu.description: This jutsu summons a powerful storm of intense winds and torrential rain. Its raindrops become sharp needles that pierce the enemy and weaken their attacks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user conjures a powerful storm, unleashing intense winds and torrential rain that soak %target(s). As the storm rages, the raindrops transform into sharp needles, piercing %target(s) and weakening the force of their attacks.

jutsu.name: Sharpened Focus
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's focus sharpens; the coming blows will land heavier.

jutsu.name: Counter Stance
jutsu.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

jutsu.name: Reapers Storm
jutsu.description: This jutsu unleashes a devastating lightning strike in the form of a demon that crashes through the clouds and slams into the target with immense force
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, summoning a torrent of water that cascades onto the battlefield in a tidal wave. The surging water drenches the area, leaving the opponent caught in the flow. With a crackling charge, %user infuses the water with lightning chakra, causing the terrain to spark and sizzle with electric energy

item.name: Lightning Crystal
item.description: A gem imbued with natural Lightning chakra. It increase Lightning damage done.

item.name: Chakra Disrupting Needles
item.description: You throw specially prepared needles that drain your target's vitality and cause their attacks to recoil against them.
item.battleDescription: Before %target can react, tiny needles strike them, draining their vitality and turning their attacks back against them.
